segments.text: Today, I'll introduce two GitHub tools that have recently gained serious attention. Let's start with GitStory.
And honestly, this one feels special.
Gittory takes your entire GitHub year and transforms it into a cinematic Instagram story style experience. Just
enter a GitHub username and suddenly your commits aren't just numbers, they're a story. You get animated slides showing your total commits, longest
streaks, busiest coding days, and even how fast you code over time. Instead of boring charts, GitStory visualizes your
text stack beautifully. GitHub U log is a GitHub CLI extension that turns your terminal into a festive animated U log fireplace. Yes, inside your terminal.
Instead of staring at plain Git logs, you're now reviewing commits while watching a cozy fire crackle. Perfect with a coffee, tea, or something stronger.
